paragraphs: SRS Computing makes management software for death care operations, available both as a desktop program and as a web-based version so directors can work from the office or from the field. The company says SRS was first in this profession to move its software to the cloud, and that more than 5,000 businesses still run on it today. SRS Computing is now part of Tribute Technology, alongside Tribute tools for websites, marketing, payments, and obituary care.

Inside the software, E-Pay Payment Processing takes credit card payments, removes double entry, and submits transactions to invoices and accounting. An online funding request filed in SRS Procession under Insurance Assignment pays out within 24 hours, with the funds flowing into Accounting through the SRS software. Electronic signatures can be created and sent on any device, so families no longer need to be present at the time of signing. Family Link gives family members a private online link for entering vital information prior to an arrangement, and the page says the tool can be used for AtNeed cases.
